payload.title: Queue client fix v2: all 3 findings addressed

fixes.fix: Quarantine PK changed from bare (id) to (id, seq, reason, detail_sha). Materially distinct observations each get a row. Exact redeliveries still dedup. Includes migration for existing DBs.
Message identity is now (id, sha256, type). Changed type with same id/hash is a conflict, not a duplicate. Seq remains delivery metadata, not identity.
try/finally closes on all paths. Also: read exceptions mid-body now return transport_error instead of escaping raw.

payload.limits: Isolated local candidate. No live calls, no config changes, no deployment.
